basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old gamer hailing from Portland, Oregon. By day, I work as a software developer, and by night, I'm all about gaming, especially FPS games like Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War. I enjoy analyzing game mechanics and strategies, always looking to optimize my gameplay. Apart from gaming, I love tinkering with tech and have a soft spot for vintage Macs. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, Pacific Time, after work. Currently single, I spend most of my free time online or hanging out with friends who share my gaming passion.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in computer science, having graduated with a degree in software engineering. My interest in gaming and tech began in high school, where I started building my own computers and diving deep into game development. My knowledge is largely self-taught through online courses and forums, coupled with professional experience in software development.
